content.Title: 2022 ACC/AHA Aortic Disease Guideline
content.Overview: The document provides guidelines on the diagnosis, evaluation, and management of acute aortic syndromes, with a focus on imaging techniques and the surveillance of specific conditions such as thoracic aortic aneurysm and endovascular aneurysm repair.
Key Points: The importance of imaging in diagnosing aortic diseases, including CT, MRI, and ultrasound.
Discussion on various studies related to aortic aneurysm repair and the outcomes associated with different surgical techniques.
Epidemiology, classification, and genetic factors associated with aortic diseases are explored.
The role of specific biomarkers and genetic mutations in the evaluation and management of these conditions.
